expectations.text: Compares three weeks for one Go developer against the roughly ten-week first-release plan and says which interview answer (effort ceiling, deadline) moved the recommendation.
expectations.evidence: The transcript does talk about the three-week window. It says three weeks of the only Go developer is 'roughly 10% of your engineering capacity', and it fits a phased v0.1.0 plan into weeks 1–3. It never compares that window to a ten-week first-release estimate. It also never names an interview answer, such as an effort ceiling or a deadline, as the thing that changed the recommendation. Instead it opens with 'I didn't look at any files' and ends with open questions it has not asked yet.
